name: seats
description: SEATS — Seating & Event Availability Tracking System. Microservices of the 2110521 group project (SE 101).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,round,tables,booking,payment,notify,staff -c green,magenta,cyan,yellow,blue,white,gray "npm -w gateway run dev" "npm -w services/concert-round run dev" "npm -w services/table-availability run dev" "npm -w services/booking run dev" "npm -w services/payment run dev" "npm -w services/notification run dev" "npm -w services/staff-account run dev"
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w frontend/shared -w frontend/customer-web-app -w frontend/back-office-web-app
scripts.test:coverage: node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='services/**/src/**' --test-coverage-include='packages/**/src/**' --test-coverage-include='gateway/src/**' --test-coverage-include='monolith/src/**' --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=80 services/*/test/*.test.ts packages/*/test/*.test.ts gateway/test/*.test.ts monolith/test/*.test.ts monolith/test/scenarios/*.test.ts
